question: In the synthetic Example Makers dataset, compare lesson counts across every module. Which module has the largest number of lessons? Return its exact title.
Find the example cohort whose start date is October 19, 2026. Locate its first-week module, then count the lessons assigned to that module. Return only the count.
For Example Makers, count the reading resources available before the cohort starts. Exclude tools and templates. Return only the count.

In the synthetic Example Makers schedule, how many elapsed UTC hours separate the first workshop from the presentation event (type demo_day)? Account for the daylight-saving transition. Return the integer hour count.

Across every lesson in Example Makers, count the lesson-to-PDF material associations. Count an attachment once per lesson even if the same worksheet is reused. Exclude CSV associations. Return only the count.
Across all Example Makers modules, how many lessons contain written content while having neither an external video URL nor a private video path? Return only the count.
Find the earliest Example Makers office-hours event, determine its module week from the cohort start date, and return the exact corresponding module title.
Find the presentation-phase module by reading the module summaries, then find its workshop. Return the workshop start as the exact UTC ISO timestamp from the event record.
For Example Makers, count distinct private storage paths among template resources. Exclude external readings/tools and do not count duplicate paths twice. Return only the count.
For the Example Makers cohort, how many separate teaching items exist if every lesson and every resource counts once, while modules and events do not count? Return only the total.
